title: Replanting the Garden
subtitle_for_page: Recovering Biblical Discipleship in Church and Family Life

description:
Many churches want to strengthen families and disciple the next generation, but they have never seen a practical, biblical model for doing it. Replanting the Garden is a two-day conference for pastors, elders, fathers, mothers and church members who want to recover a Scripture-shaped vision for church and family life.

This isn’t a campaign against anything. It’s a return to something beautiful: fathers leading their homes, mothers taking up their high calling, elders equipping the whole flock, and old and young gathered together before the Lord to worship, to hear His Word, and to learn from one another.

Scott Brown and Justin Miller will walk through the biblical pattern for multi-generational discipleship, how the church came to separate the generations, what belongs to the family and what belongs to the church, and how a congregation can make wise, patient changes without tearing anything up. You’ll go home with next steps, not just principles.

Hosted by Faith Community Church in Bainbridge, Georgia.

What you’ll take home

  • A biblical vision for the generations together
  • Clear lines of responsibility for fathers, mothers and elders
  • Practical help for family worship and children in the worship service
  • Gracious answers to common objections
  • A patient roadmap for change
